research_findings.headline: CRITICAL CORRECTION: creator_prior_peak_mcap_ceiling_signal's 'prior track record unlocks a higher ceiling tier' reframing (research-153/154) is REFUTED -- 3 clean independent creator pairs (GOAT->TOGA, Alchemist AI->WikiCoin, Ban->VOID) all show the LATER launch capping 100x-2500x BELOW the creator's earlier viral peak, not above it. Meanwhile REQ-027's WC span-bucket gate math is fully CONFIRMED with zero discrepancies (N=15, TIGHT 50%WR/MEDIUM 75%WR/WIDE 22.2%WR exact match) and formally closes out. New hypothesis: graduation_mcap_velocity_wash_flag, triggered by today's suspicious $115M-$269M pump.fun graduations inside a same-day 'US Reserve' copycat wave.

new_hypothesis.name: graduation_mcap_velocity_wash_flag
new_hypothesis.mechanism: A token that reaches an implausibly large market cap within a very short window after pump.fun graduation (tens-to-hundreds of millions of dollars within 1-6 hours, sometimes minutes) has not had time for genuine organic price discovery -- real demand requires independent traders to discover, evaluate, and decide to buy, a process that normally takes many hours to days to push a fresh graduate into 8-9 figure market cap territory. Near-instant huge mcaps are a strong signature of wash trading or insider self-funded volume manufacturing the appearance of organic momentum, often riding a copycat narrative wave (near-simultaneous same-theme launches) to add false legitimacy.
new_hypothesis.persistence: The signal requires cross-referencing graduation timestamp against mcap velocity -- something momentum-chasing bots and scanners (including this bot's own fresh-graduate strategies) don't currently check; they read 'high mcap + high momentum' as bullish, not suspicious. Because the mispricing this creates is exactly what attracts the copy-trading bots the wash-traders are trying to fool, the exploit doesn't get arbitraged away by the very participants it targets.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase-1 LOG-ONLY. For any candidate token with pair_age (hours since graduation) < 6h, compute mcap / pair_age_hours as a velocity ratio. Log this alongside existing trade features for every entry across strategies that can fire on fresh graduates (fresh_profile, fresh_boost, consensus_boost, etc). Flag HIGH-VELOCITY-SUSPICIOUS if mcap already exceeds roughly $20-50M within the first hour post-graduation, or if the token is part of a same-day multi-token copycat cluster (3+ similarly-named/themed tokens graduating within hours of each other). No filter change yet -- accumulate against forward 24h/7d outcome to test whether flagged tokens crash harder/faster than unflagged fast-graduates (which already crash a lot per this run's watchlist follow-up, so the bar is whether flagged ones crash MORE and FASTER).
new_hypothesis.data_required: pair_age (already tracked, used in fresh_profile's H11 gate) + current mcap (already fetched via DexScreener on every candidate) -- a derived-field logging addition only, zero new API calls or keys.
new_hypothesis.evidence: This run's graduation scout found TNOS (mint 6AZL27wiiFzXTtAeCsTJ3FWytfCGYjBo89G25sagpump) at $269M mcap ~1h post-graduation, USUR (mint i1rYqJz3beZk5nYeGcJgUmgwtfEUWJ4ofyTj7p5pump) at $115.9M ~3.4h post-graduation, and USOC (mint vMtVhiRkvpgFPk5t7JsFoKQbJ7CHBYjYd9TLf7Upump) at $10.9M ~54min post-graduation -- all three part of a same-day 'US Strategic Reserve/Fund' copycat wave (USUR/USOC/USON/SAOF/USOP graduating within hours of each other, identical narrative template). Separately, this run's watchlist follow-up on 4 tokens flagged exactly one week ago (2FACER, Evildogi, JIMOSUMMER, CHANGE -- all fast graduations that hit large ATHs within minutes) found ALL FOUR are now dead or near-zero (>95% down from ATH within days, one delisted entirely), directly corroborating 'fast huge pump = doesn't hold' as a recurring pattern, not a one-off.
